reviewer.name: Independent host Chinese-source review of peer-authored supplemental repairs

proposals.before: Once he was playing on the palace steps with the imperial princes; when Emperor Hui came to audience he took each prince's hand in turn; when he reached the crown prince, Emperor Wu said, 'This is your son.'
proposals.after: Once he was playing in the palace hall with the imperial princes; when Emperor Hui came to audience he took each prince's hand in turn; when he reached the crown prince, Emperor Wu said, 'This is your son.'
proposals.reason: 嘗與諸皇子共戲殿上 is in the hall, not on palace steps.

proposals.before: Mi quoted Yu vowing to slaughter the Jias after Jia died.
proposals.after: I have secretly heard him say: 'After the empress dies, I shall butcher them.'
proposals.reason: 密聞其言云 continues Jia Mi’s speech opened at s0037; the original is third-person paraphrase and drops the quoted words 皇后萬歲後，吾當魚肉之.

proposals.before: Everyone saw Jia meant to kill the heir.
proposals.after: Then court and countryside knew the empress meant to harm the crown prince.
proposals.reason: 于時朝野咸知賈后有害太子意 is harm, not kill, and names court and countryside.

proposals.before: Or I will kill her myself.
proposals.after: if she does not, I shall end her life with my own hands.
proposals.reason: 不了，吾當手了之 continues the forged text and specifies 手; the original drops the conditional.

proposals.before: Let this sworn petition take effect as commanded.
proposals.after: Let this sworn petition take effect as commanded."
proposals.reason: 要疏如律令。」 closes the forged text opened with 「 at s0048; the literal lacks the closing quotation mark.
南風，后名 is the empress’s name; the idiomatic line is missing the opening quotation mark, as was the literal.

proposals.before: Inner attendants Chen Wu told him: 'The empress vomited ill this morning.'
proposals.after: Inner attendants Chen Wu told me: 'The empress vomited ill this morning.'
proposals.reason: The letter opened at s0074 is first person; 見語 is spoken to the writer.

proposals.before: She told you to wait seated in an empty chamber.
proposals.after: She told me to wait seated in an empty chamber.
proposals.reason: 使住空屋中坐 continues the first-person letter; “you” is the wrong person.

proposals.before: She brought three sheng of ale and a great tray of jujubes and made him finish both.
proposals.after: She brought three sheng of ale and a great tray of jujubes and made me finish both.
proposals.reason: The letter is first person; 使飲酒啖棗盡 is what was done to the writer.

proposals.before: Pressed helplessly he drank another sheng.
proposals.after: Pressed helplessly I drank another sheng.
proposals.reason: 逼迫不得已，更飲一升 continues the first-person letter.

proposals.before: After drinking his body grew confused and he lost awareness.
proposals.after: After drinking, my body grew confused and I lost awareness.
proposals.reason: 飲已，體中荒迷，不復自覺 continues the first-person letter.

proposals.before: Another small maid, Chengfu, brought brush, inkstone, and yellow paper, making him write.
proposals.after: Another small maid, Chengfu, brought brush, inkstone, and yellow paper, making me write.
proposals.reason: 使寫 in the letter is first person.

proposals.before: Parents are kin closest of all—I truly did not doubt them; though matters went so, I have been slandered, and I trust the multitude will see it clear.'
proposals.after: Parents are kin closest of all—I truly did not doubt them; though matters went so, I have been slandered, and I trust the multitude will see it clear."
proposals.reason: s0106 closes the letter opened with 「 at s0074; the idiomatic opening at s0074 uses a double quotation mark, so this close must match and not introduce a single-quote boundary.

decisions.reason: 殿上 is the palace hall, not the steps; same correction independently made in the paired idiomatic decision.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 嘗與諸皇子共戲殿上，惠帝來朝，執諸皇子手，次至太子，帝曰：「是汝兒也。」

decisions.reason: 密聞其言云 reports first-person speech inside Jia Mi’s continuing statement. 皇后萬歲後，吾當魚肉之 retains death and threatened butchery.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 密聞其言云：'皇后萬歲後，吾當魚肉之。

decisions.reason: 朝野咸知 and 有害太子意 support court and countryside knowing an intention to harm, without changing harm into killing.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 于時朝野咸知賈后有害太子意。

decisions.reason: 不了 supplies the condition and 手了之 specifies killing with one’s own hands; continues the forged document.
Chinese closes the forged text opened in s0048; preserve the full text and add only its missing closing double quote.
南風，后名 identifies the empress’s name; restore both English quote boundaries around its translation.

decisions.after: Chen Wu, an attendant of the empress, told me: 'The empress vomited this morning and is unwell.'
decisions.reason: The first-person letter opened in s0074 governs 見語: Chen Wu spoke to the letter writer, not to a third person.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 中宮左右陳舞見語：'中宮旦來吐不快。

decisions.after: I was made to sit in an empty chamber.
decisions.reason: The first-person letter governs the omitted recipient of 使住空屋中坐. Passive wording preserves it without assigning an unsupported speaker.
In the same letter 見與 and 使飲酒啖棗盡 make the writer recipient and consumer; preserve three sheng and large platter of jujubes.

sourceWitness.excerpt: '便持三升酒、大盤棗來見與，使飲酒啖棗盡。

decisions.reason: 逼迫不得已，更飲一升 continues the letter writer’s own account and gives one further sheng.
體中荒迷，不復自覺 describes the letter writer’s body and loss of awareness in first person.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 飲已，體中荒迷，不復自覺。

decisions.reason: 小婢承福 and 筆研墨黃紙 supply maid Chengfu, brush, inkstone/ink and yellow paper; 使寫 addresses the first-person writer.

sourceWitness.excerpt: '又小婢承福持筆研墨黃紙來，使寫。

decisions.reason: The idiomatic letter opens with a double quotation at s0074 and Chinese closes it here; match that closing boundary.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 父母至親，實不相疑，事理如此，實為見誣，想眾人見明也。」
